summary:
Brazil is voting in a close presidential race between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. The first round follows final campaign rallies in São Paulo, a state that accounts for a fifth of the national vote. In Kyiv, a Russian drone struck the North Bridge shortly after German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived on an unannounced visit with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Merz is expected to announce further support for Ukraine, including plans for drone production.

The United Arab Emirates called a Flydubai co-pilot’s assault on the captain a planned terrorist act. The co-pilot reportedly used a crash axe on the Israel-bound flight, but crew members overpowered him and the plane landed safely with 182 people aboard. Yemen’s Houthi rebels claimed attacks on an Aramco facility near Riyadh, where residents reported flames and smoke; a spokesman for the Saudi-led coalition called the claims misleading.

Searchers found a debris field from a medical transport aircraft that went missing over the Atlantic while flying from Bermuda toward Boston. Flight data showed a sharp drop in altitude before contact with controllers was lost. In Spain, tens of thousands marched in Madrid and other cities after parliament rejected government measures to address the housing crisis; more than 50 protests took place on Saturday.

headlines.title: Brazil votes in close Lula–Bolsonaro presidential race
headlines.summary: Brazilians are voting in a closely contested presidential election between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. The first round follows final campaign rallies in São Paulo, where a fifth of the national vote is based.

headlines.title: Russia strikes Kyiv bridge during Merz’s surprise visit
headlines.summary: A Russian drone struck Kyiv’s North Bridge shortly after German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived for an unannounced visit with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Merz is expected to announce further support, including plans for drone production.

headlines.title: UAE calls Flydubai cockpit attack a planned terrorist act
headlines.summary: The UAE says a Flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe on a flight bound for Israel, but crew members overpowered him and the plane landed safely. The aircraft was carrying 182 people.

headlines.title: Houthis claim attacks on Aramco facilities near Riyadh
headlines.summary: Yemen’s Houthi rebels claimed they struck an oil facility belonging to Aramco near Riyadh, where residents reported flames and smoke. A spokesman for the Saudi-led coalition called the claims misleading.

headlines.title: Debris found in search for medical flight missing off Bermuda
headlines.summary: Searchers found a debris field from a medical transport aircraft that went missing over the Atlantic while travelling from Bermuda toward Boston. Flight data showed a sharp drop in altitude before contact with air traffic controllers was lost.

headlines.title: Tens of thousands protest Spain’s housing crisis
headlines.summary: Demonstrators marched in Madrid and other Spanish cities after parliament rejected government measures to tackle the housing crisis. More than 50 protests were held on Saturday.

headlines.title: North Korea says it tested intermediate-range missile
headlines.summary: North Korea said it test-fired an intermediate-range ballistic missile with manoeuvrable flight capabilities. It claimed the weapon travelled 1,000 kilometres, about 300 kilometres farther than estimates from Japan and South Korea.

headlines.title: Japan protests after US Marine arrested over Okinawa killing
headlines.summary: A 20-year-old US Marine was arrested in Okinawa on suspicion of robbing and murdering a local woman. Japan’s prime minister pressed the United States over the case, which has revived tensions over the US military presence on the island.
